tools.title: queryEmployeeCompensationEntries

parameters.name: $skip
parameters.description: The number of events to skip before beginning to return events in the response

parameters.name: $top
parameters.description: The maximum number of events to return in the response

parameters.name: $filter
parameters.description: The filter operation (eq and in) for compPlanId, formDataId, location, department, and division

parameters.name: $expand
parameters.description: The expand operation for salary, bonus, stock, varpay, commentList, and ratingInfos

parameters.name: $select
parameters.description: The selection operation for standard and custom fields
